notes: The two articles of ho tou tektonos huios were swapped: the accepted alignment gave *the* to the head noun's article and emptied the genitive's article. Rule 20 empties an article whose noun's determiner slot is taken by an English *'s*, and the *the* the ASV wrote determines *carpenter*, which is the genitive's own noun.

Reading *the* as the determiner of the whole phrase *the carpenter's son*, and so as the outer article's, is the competing analysis; it is refused because rule 20 names the *'s* displacement in terms and rule 57 cites tes Kaisaros oikias for exactly this shape.
13:15's this people's heart is the chapter's control and is analysed the same way: the inner article is decided by the determiner standing in front of the inner noun.
Everything else in the verse is unchanged, including ouchi taking *not* under rule 64 and the discontinuous *is ... called* on s012.
